App.Title: YokoWave
Action.StopAllTip: Set every device output to zero · Esc
Device.GroupHelp: Select devices to link their output. Each device keeps its own limit.
Device.SimulationHelp: Simulated devices send no Bluetooth commands. Connect a device and set channel levels before starting.
Wave.LibraryHelp: Select a waveform to preview it. Copy built-ins, edit custom waveforms, or import and export JSON.
Wave.Name: Name
Wave.PointsHelp: Custom samples · values from 0 to 1, separated by commas
Wave.EditorPreview: Editor preview · shown for valid parameters
Transfer.Title: Import and export
Transfer.Help: Use a JSON file or paste JSON. Existing IDs are skipped; built-in waveforms are retained.
Transfer.Placeholder: Paste waveform JSON here, or select Generate JSON
History.Help: Sessions are saved locally when they end. Up to 500 records are retained.
Settings.AppearanceHelp: Theme and accent color follow system settings and update automatically on supported platforms.
Settings.SimulationHelp: Devices, battery levels, signals, and output are simulated. Real Bluetooth devices are not connected.
Settings.DefaultLimit: Default output limit for new connections
Settings.Offset: Offset channel B by half a period
Settings.StorageHelp: Custom waveforms, settings, and sessions are stored on this device.
Settings.StopHelp: Output starts at zero on launch and reconnection. Changing devices or pages, reaching the time limit, or closing the app stops the session. Esc stops all output.
Device.ConnectHelp: Connect a device to set channel levels and output limits
Wave.Sine.Name: Sine wave
Wave.Triangle.Name: Triangle wave
Wave.Pulse.Name: Pulse wave
Wave.Ramp.Name: Stepped ramp
Wave.Sine.Description: Normalized values follow a sine curve from 0 to 1.
Wave.Triangle.Description: Normalized values rise linearly to 1, then fall to 0.
Wave.Pulse.Description: Output is 1 for the first 40% of each period, then 0.
Wave.Ramp.Description: Output increases from 0 to 1 in five steps per period.
Status.Generated: Waveform JSON generated. Copy it or save it to a file.
Status.Discovered: Simulated devices found: {0}. Real Bluetooth devices were not scanned.
Status.Stopped: All device outputs set to zero.
Status.CopyBuiltIn: The built-in waveform will be saved as a copy.
Error.WaveName: A waveform needs a valid ID and a name of 1–60 characters.
Error.Period: Period must be between 0.2 and 60 seconds.
Error.Frequency: Frequency must be between 1 and 100 Hz.
Error.Points: Custom waveforms need 2–256 samples between 0 and 1.
Error.StopUnconfirmed: Some devices did not confirm that output stopped.
Error.SelectConnected: Connect and select at least one device first.
Error.Duration: Session duration must be between 1 second and 120 minutes.
Error.CorruptWorkspace: Local data could not be read. The original file was retained. Check it, or back it up and move workspace.json before saving.
Error.FileSize: Waveform files must not exceed 1 MB.
Error.ImportCount: Import between 1 and 100 waveforms at a time.
Error.DuplicateIds: The file contains duplicate waveform IDs.
Error.SetLevel: Set a channel level before starting a session.
Error.DeleteBuiltIn: Built-in waveforms cannot be deleted. Create a copy instead.
Error.InvalidJson: Unable to read JSON. Check the file format.
Device.Include: Include in the next linked session
